info.name: Kiselgram API v2
info.description:
V2 API endpoints for Kiselgram messaging platform.

Base URL: {{base_url}}/api.v2/api
Auth: Bearer token via {{auth_token}} variable

Register → Login → use session_token as bearer token for other requests.
